---
title: "Combining data into tables for WV"
format: html
---

**This is processing a generated xlxs spreadsheet for all 10 states counties data collected and focusing just on wv to see how we might analyze what weve collected**

```{r}
library(openxlsx)
```

```{r}
PROJECT_DIR <- "/Users/sophiameyers/Documents/GitHub/USGS-Gages-Research"

# Generated workbook containing all 10 states
SOURCE_XLSX <- file.path(
  PROJECT_DIR,
  "data",
  "intermediate",
  "GENERATED_Historical_Floods_Population_Streamgages_10_States.xlsx"
)

OUTPUT_XLSX <- file.path(
  PROJECT_DIR,
  "West_Virginia_Historical_Floods.xlsx"
)
```



```{r}

all_sheets <- getSheetNames(SOURCE_XLSX)

state_codes <- unique(
  substr(
    all_sheets[grepl("^[A-Z]{2}_", all_sheets)],
    1,
    2
  )
)

state_codes <- sort(state_codes)

cat("States identified:", length(state_codes), "\n")
print(state_codes)


wb <- createWorkbook()


for (state in state_codes) {

  cat("Processing state:", state, "\n")

  state_sheets <- all_sheets[
    grepl(paste0("^", state, "_"), all_sheets)
  ]

  addWorksheet(wb, state)

  current_row <- 1

  for (sheet_name in state_sheets) {

    cat("  Processing:", sheet_name, "\n")

    county_data <- read.xlsx(
      SOURCE_XLSX,
      sheet = sheet_name,
      rows = 1:13,
      cols = 1:9,
      colNames = FALSE,
      skipEmptyRows = FALSE,
      skipEmptyCols = FALSE
    )

    county_data <- as.data.frame(county_data)

    while (ncol(county_data) < 9) {
      county_data[[ncol(county_data) + 1]] <- NA
    }

    writeData(
      wb,
      sheet = state,
      x = county_data,
      startRow = current_row,
      startCol = 1,
      colNames = FALSE,
      rowNames = FALSE
    )

    current_row <- current_row + 15
  }

  cat(
    "  County sections:",
    length(state_sheets),
    "\n"
  )
}


saveWorkbook(
  wb,
  OUTPUT_XLSX,
  overwrite = TRUE
)

cat("10-state workbook created!\n")
cat("Number of state tabs:", length(state_codes), "\n")
cat("States:", paste(state_codes, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Output file:", OUTPUT_XLSX, "\n")

```


**Now have a file called Processed/Test_States_Data_Combined.xlsx with every states data collected so far in a workbook* called **

**Now creating some graphs in west virginia to see trends over time for each of the rows**

```{r}

library(openxlsx)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)


PROJECT_DIR <- "/Users/sophiameyers/Documents/GitHub/USGS-Gages-Research"

SOURCE_XLSX <- file.path(
  PROJECT_DIR,
  "data",
  "processed",
  "Test_States_Data_Combined.xlsx"
)
PLOT_DIR <- file.path(
  PROJECT_DIR,
  "outputs",
  "WV_trend_plots"
)

dir.create(
  PLOT_DIR,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

if (!file.exists(SOURCE_XLSX)) {
  stop("Source workbook not found: ", SOURCE_XLSX)
}


cat("Reading West Virginia data...\n")

sheets <- getSheetNames(SOURCE_XLSX)

print(sheets)

if (!"WV" %in% sheets) {
  stop("A worksheet named WV was not found.")
}

wv <- read.xlsx(
  SOURCE_XLSX,
  sheet = "WV",
  colNames = FALSE,
  skipEmptyRows = FALSE,
  skipEmptyCols = FALSE
)


metric_rows <- which(
  trimws(as.character(wv[[1]])) == "Metric"
)

cat(
  "County tables identified:",
  length(metric_rows),
  "\n"
)

if (length(metric_rows) == 0) {
  stop("No county Metric headers found.")
}

years <- as.numeric(
  as.character(
    unlist(wv[metric_rows[1], 2:9])
  )
)

cat("Decades identified:\n")
print(years)


county_tables <- list()

for (i in seq_along(metric_rows)) {

  header_row <- metric_rows[i]

  # County name is three rows above Metric header
  county_name <- as.character(
    wv[[1]][header_row - 3]
  )

  # Determine end of county section
  next_header <- if (i < length(metric_rows)) {
    metric_rows[i + 1]
  } else {
    nrow(wv) + 1
  }

  # Metric rows are immediately below header
  metric_start <- header_row + 1
  metric_end <- next_header - 1

  # Find first blank row after metric header
  first_blank <- which(
    is.na(wv[[1]][metric_start:metric_end]) |
      trimws(as.character(
        wv[[1]][metric_start:metric_end]
      )) == ""
  )

  if (length(first_blank) > 0) {
    metric_end <- metric_start + first_blank[1] - 2
  }

  if (metric_end < metric_start) next

  metric_data <- wv[
    metric_start:metric_end,
    1:9,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  for (j in seq_len(nrow(metric_data))) {

    metric_name <- as.character(
      metric_data[[1]][j]
    )

    if (is.na(metric_name) || trimws(metric_name) == "") {
      next
    }

    values <- suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(
        as.character(
          unlist(metric_data[j, 2:9])
        )
      )
    )

    county_tables[[length(county_tables) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      County = county_name,
      Metric = metric_name,
      Year = years,
      Value = values
    )
  }
}

wv_long <- bind_rows(county_tables)

cat("Extracted records:\n")
print(dim(wv_long))

cat("Metrics identified:\n")
print(unique(wv_long$Metric))


wv_statewide <- wv_long %>%
  group_by(Metric, Year) %>%
  summarise(
    Value = if (all(is.na(Value))) {
      NA_real_
    } else {
      sum(Value, na.rm = TRUE)
    },
    Counties_Reporting = sum(!is.na(Value)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("Statewide results:\n")

print(
  wv_statewide,
  n = Inf
)

write.csv(
  wv_statewide,
  file.path(PLOT_DIR, "WV_statewide_trends.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)


plots <- list()

column_metrics <- c(
  "FEMA flood declarations",
  "NFIP paid claims",
  "NOAA flood events"
)

for (metric in unique(wv_statewide$Metric)) {

  plot_data <- wv_statewide %>%
    filter(Metric == metric) %>%
    arrange(Year)

  if (metric %in% column_metrics) {

    p <- ggplot(
      plot_data,
      aes(x = Year, y = Value)
    ) +
      geom_col(
        na.rm = TRUE
      )

  } else {

    p <- ggplot(
      plot_data,
      aes(x = Year, y = Value)
    ) +
      geom_line(
        linewidth = 0.9,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ) +
      geom_point(
        size = 2.5,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
  }

  p <- p +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = years
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste(metric, "- West Virginia"),
      subtitle = "Statewide sum of county-level values",
      x = "Decade",
      y = metric
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = 14
      ),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(
        size = 10
      ),
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 45,
        hjust = 1
      ),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )

  plots[[metric]] <- p

  print(p)

  safe_name <- str_replace_all(
    tolower(metric),
    "[^a-z0-9]+",
    "_"
  )

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(
      PLOT_DIR,
      paste0("WV_", safe_name, ".png")
    ),
    plot = p,
    width = 9,
    height = 5,
    dpi = 300
  )
}


```
**Now have /intermediate/WV_statewide_trends.csv with row total temporally, used to make these graphics and these graphics for WV saved to graphics/WV_trend_plots**

**Next creating the same grpahics but by county**

```{r}

PROJECT_DIR <- "/Users/sophiameyers/Documents/GitHub/USGS-Gages-Research"

SOURCE_XLSX <- file.path(
  PROJECT_DIR,
  "data",
  "processed",
  "Test_States_Data_Combined.xlsx"
)

STATE_OUTPUT_DIR <- file.path(
  PROJECT_DIR,
  "outputs",
  "WV_historical_trends"
)

STATE_PLOT_DIR <- file.path(
  STATE_OUTPUT_DIR,
  "Statewide_Graphs"
)

COUNTY_OUTPUT_DIR <- file.path(
  PROJECT_DIR,
  "outputs",
  "WV_county_historical_trends"
)

COUNTY_PLOT_DIR <- file.path(
  COUNTY_OUTPUT_DIR,
  "County_Comparison_Graphs"
)

dir.create(
  STATE_PLOT_DIR,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

dir.create(
  COUNTY_PLOT_DIR,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)



if (!file.exists(SOURCE_XLSX)) {
  stop(
    "Source workbook not found: ",
    SOURCE_XLSX
  )
}

cat("Source workbook found!\n")

sheets <- getSheetNames(SOURCE_XLSX)

cat("Available worksheets:\n")
print(sheets)

if (!"WV" %in% sheets) {
  stop("A worksheet named WV was not found.")
}


cat("Reading West Virginia worksheet...\n")

wv <- read.xlsx(
  SOURCE_XLSX,
  sheet = "WV",
  colNames = FALSE,
  skipEmptyRows = FALSE,
  skipEmptyCols = FALSE
)

cat("Worksheet dimensions:\n")
print(dim(wv))


metric_rows <- which(
  !is.na(wv[[1]]) &
    trimws(as.character(wv[[1]])) == "Metric"
)

cat(
  "County tables identified:",
  length(metric_rows),
  "\n"
)

if (length(metric_rows) == 0) {
  stop("No county Metric headers found.")
}

years <- suppressWarnings(
  as.numeric(
    as.character(
      unlist(wv[metric_rows[1], 2:9])
    )
  )
)

cat("Decades identified:\n")
print(years)

if (length(years) != 8 || any(is.na(years))) {
  stop("Could not correctly identify the eight decade columns.")
}



cat("Extracting county-level data...\n")

county_tables <- list()

for (i in seq_along(metric_rows)) {

  header_row <- metric_rows[i]

  county_name <- as.character(
    wv[[1]][header_row - 3]
  )

  if (
    length(county_name) == 0 ||
    is.na(county_name) ||
    trimws(county_name) == ""
  ) {
    warning(
      paste("Could not identify county name at row", header_row)
    )
    next
  }

  county_name <- trimws(county_name)

  next_header <- if (i < length(metric_rows)) {
    metric_rows[i + 1]
  } else {
    nrow(wv) + 1
  }

  metric_start <- header_row + 1
  metric_end <- next_header - 1

  if (metric_start > nrow(wv)) next

  first_blank <- which(
    is.na(wv[[1]][metric_start:metric_end]) |
      trimws(
        as.character(wv[[1]][metric_start:metric_end])
      ) == ""
  )

  if (length(first_blank) > 0) {
    metric_end <- metric_start + first_blank[1] - 2
  }

  if (metric_end < metric_start) next

  metric_data <- wv[
    metric_start:metric_end,
    1:9,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  for (j in seq_len(nrow(metric_data))) {

    metric_name <- as.character(
      metric_data[[1]][j]
    )

    if (
      length(metric_name) == 0 ||
      is.na(metric_name) ||
      trimws(metric_name) == ""
    ) {
      next
    }

    values <- suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(
        as.character(
          unlist(metric_data[j, 2:9])
        )
      )
    )

    if (length(values) != length(years)) {
      warning(
        paste(
          "Unexpected number of decade values for",
          county_name,
          "-",
          metric_name
        )
      )
      next
    }

    county_tables[[length(county_tables) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      County = rep(county_name, length(years)),
      Metric = rep(trimws(metric_name), length(years)),
      Year = years,
      Value = values
    )
  }
}

wv_long <- bind_rows(county_tables)

wv_long <- wv_long %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(County),
    trimws(County) != "",
    !is.na(Metric),
    trimws(Metric) != ""
  )

cat("Extraction complete!\n")

cat(
  "Counties extracted:",
  length(unique(wv_long$County)),
  "\n"
)

cat("County names:\n")
print(sort(unique(wv_long$County)))

cat("Metric names:\n")
print(unique(wv_long$Metric))


wv_long <- bind_rows(county_tables) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(County),
    trimws(County) != "",
    !is.na(Metric),
    trimws(Metric) != ""
  )

cat("\nExtraction complete!\n")

cat(
  "Counties extracted:",
  length(unique(wv_long$County)),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Metrics extracted:",
  length(unique(wv_long$Metric)),
  "\n"
)

cat("\nCounty names:\n")
print(sort(unique(wv_long$County)))

cat("\nMetric names:\n")
print(unique(wv_long$Metric))


write.csv(
  wv_long,
  file.path(
    COUNTY_OUTPUT_DIR,
    "WV_county_level_data.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE,
  na = ""
)


wv_statewide <- wv_long %>%
  group_by(Metric, Year) %>%
  summarise(

    Value = if (all(is.na(Value))) {
      NA_real_
    } else {
      sum(Value, na.rm = TRUE)
    },

    Counties_Reporting = sum(!is.na(Value)),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("\nStatewide summary:\n")

print(
  wv_statewide,
  n = Inf
)


write.csv(
  wv_statewide,
  file.path(
    STATE_OUTPUT_DIR,
    "WV_statewide_trends.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE,
  na = ""
)


cat("\nCreating statewide graphs...\n")

state_plots <- list()

column_metrics <- c(
  "FEMA flood declarations",
  "NFIP paid claims",
  "NOAA flood events"
)

for (metric in unique(wv_statewide$Metric)) {

  plot_data <- wv_statewide %>%
    filter(Metric == metric) %>%
    arrange(Year)

  if (metric %in% column_metrics) {

    p <- ggplot(
      plot_data,
      aes(x = Year, y = Value)
    ) +
      geom_col(
        na.rm = TRUE
      )

  } else {

    p <- ggplot(
      plot_data,
      aes(x = Year, y = Value)
    ) +
      geom_line(
        linewidth = 0.9,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ) +
      geom_point(
        size = 2.5,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
  }

  p <- p +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = years
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste(metric, "- West Virginia"),
      subtitle = "Statewide sum of county-level values",
      x = "Decade",
      y = metric
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = 14
      ),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(
        size = 10
      ),
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 45,
        hjust = 1
      ),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )

  state_plots[[metric]] <- p

  print(p)

  safe_name <- str_replace_all(
    tolower(metric),
    "[^a-z0-9]+",
    "_"
  )

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(
      STATE_PLOT_DIR,
      paste0("WV_", safe_name, ".png")
    ),
    plot = p,
    width = 9,
    height = 5,
    dpi = 300
  )
}


cat("\nCreating county comparison graphs...\n")

county_plots <- list()

for (metric in unique(wv_long$Metric)) {

  plot_data <- wv_long %>%
    filter(
      Metric == metric,
      !is.na(County),
      trimws(County) != ""
    ) %>%
    arrange(County, Year)

  p <- ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(
      x = Year,
      y = Value,
      color = County,
      group = County
    )
  ) +

    geom_line(
      linewidth = 0.8,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +

    geom_point(
      size = 1.8,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +

    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = years
    ) +

    labs(
      title = paste(
        metric,
        "- West Virginia Counties"
      ),
      subtitle = "Historical comparison across counties",
      x = "Decade",
      y = metric,
      color = "County"
    ) +

    theme_minimal() +

    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = 14
      ),

      plot.subtitle = element_text(
        size = 10
      ),

      axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 45,
        hjust = 1
      ),

      legend.position = "right",

      legend.text = element_text(
        size = 8
      ),

      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )

  county_plots[[metric]] <- p

  print(p)

  safe_name <- str_replace_all(
    tolower(metric),
    "[^a-z0-9]+",
    "_"
  )

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(
      COUNTY_PLOT_DIR,
      paste0(
        "WV_counties_",
        safe_name,
        ".png"
      )
    ),
    plot = p,
    width = 12,
    height = 7,
    dpi = 300
  )
}


```
